question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should inline autogrow plus the modifier-send setting remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a second composer mode whose draft, attachment, focus, and send semantics are product/UX choices rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build the requested modal editor in the chat composer surface with separate modal draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Declare the current autogrow textarea plus modifier-send setting sufficient for long prompts and close or narrow this request accordingly.

options.title: Defer Mode Choice
options.body: Keep this issue open but out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build the requested modal editor in the chat composer surface with separate modal draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest adjacent send-shortcut ownership and prior review context for this issue.
